slug: 2024-09-17 Rwanda conducts pilot to implement biometric SIM registration, verification

facts.fact: A pilot of biometric SIM registration was launched under the new RURA regulations, which require operators to verify customers' fingerprints and face against NIDA data and to link each SIM to the owner's unique identification number.
facts.system: Biometric SIM card registration and verification

systems.system: Biometric SIM card registration and verification

slug: 2024-08-09 Regulation Governing SIM Card Registration in Rwanda (RURA No.18-2024)

facts.fact: RURA Regulation No. 18/R/SM-ICT/RURA/2024 of 9 August 2024 sets up SIM-registration rules that include identity verification against the national-ID database.
